name: atNorth SWE04 Sollefteå mega site
summary: atNorth announced in February 2026 a 300 MW campus, SWE04, at Hamre Industrial Park in Långsele, about 7 km west of Sollefteå in northern Sweden, on a zoned plot it describes as 50 hectares, with operation expected in the first half of 2028. In June 2026 it published a consultation document for an environmental permit application to the Land and Environment Court, describing three main buildings on a property of about 16 hectares, 145 backup generators running on HVO or similar fuel with about 1,200 MW of combustion input, and a planned grid connection agreement with E.ON. Investment has not been disclosed.

location.note: Site is the Hamre property (Hamre 4:87 after subdivision) in Hamre Industrial Park, Långsele; the Långsele village centroid from Nominatim is used because the parcel was not geocoded.

parties.name: atNorth AB
parties.note: The consultation document lists atNorth AB as owner of the land within the site.

parties.name: E.ON
parties.note: atNorth states it will sign a grid connection agreement with E.ON.

metrics.note: The FAQ on atNorth's site page cites a 200 MW path to power, conflicting with the 300 MW headline on the same page.
The site page FAQ separately calls the campus 4 hectares, which conflicts with its own 50-hectare headline.
The consultation document gives the property area as about 160,000 square metres, smaller than the 50 hectares in atNorth's announcement.
Three main buildings of roughly 160 by 130 metres, up to 26 metres high.

milestones.note: Consultation document published ahead of an environmental permit application to the Land and Environment Court, with Västernorrland County Administrative Board as supervisory authority.

power_sources.description: Grid connection agreement to be signed with E.ON; atNorth cites renewable energy access at the park.
145 backup generators running on HVO, biodiesel or similar fuel, with total installed combustion input of about 1,200 MW and fuel for up to 24 hours.
